experiences.name: Vršič and the Trenta Gate
experiences.description: Slovenia's best-known pass: the Vršič climbs past the Russian chapel through fifty numbered hairpins, then drops into the Trenta valley beside the young Soča. Short, intense and best ridden early before the tour buses arrive.

sights.name: Cerkev posvečena žrtvam odseka Planina Zagreben
Cerkev Svete Device Marije v polju

experiences.name: Soča Valley to Ljubljana
experiences.description: Follow the emerald Soča down from Bovec through Kobarid and Tolmin, then climb over the hills to the old mercury-mining town of Idrija before the easy run to the capital. A day that goes from alpine river scenery to gentle forest roads and ends in a city.

sights.name: Župnijska cerkev svetih Urha in sv. Martina

experiences.name: Bled, Bohinj and Soriška Planina
experiences.description: Start at the island lake of Bled, ride through the Bohinj basin and climb the narrow Soriška planina road, one of the favourite twisty roads of Slovenian riders. The descent through Železniki lands you in Škofja Loka.

experiences.name: Cerknica Lake to the Vipava Valley
experiences.description: A relaxed crossing of Notranjska: the karst lake basin at Cerknica, the cave town of Postojna and the drop into the sunny, wine-growing Vipava Valley. Gentle curves, small villages and plenty of cafe stops.

sights.name: Župnijska cerkev svetih Urha in sv. Martina

experiences.name: Coast, Karst and Štanjel
experiences.description: From the Venetian harbour town of Piran to Koper, then inland through the stone villages of the Karst past the Lipica stud farm and the hilltop village of Štanjel. It ends in Nova Gorica on the Italian border.

sights.name: Rožnovenska Mati Božja / Madre del Rosario
Rimska vila in pristanišče Haliaetum Izola
Cerkev svetega Nikolaja (Miklavža) / Chiesa di San Nicolò
Chiesa di Sant'Andrea Apostolo / Cerkev Svetega Andreja apostola

experiences.name: Ljubljana Hills to Kranj
experiences.description: A quick escape from the capital into the Polhov Gradec hills, then through the Poljane valley to the medieval old town of Škofja Loka and on to Kranj. Rolling wooded roads and small villages; good as an evening ride or a gentle first day.

sights.name: Cerkev sv. Simona in Jude Tadeja

experiences.name: Kamnik to the Logar Valley
experiences.description: Cross the Črnivec pass from Kamnik to Gornji Grad, follow the Savinja up to Luče and Solčava and finish in the glacial Logar Valley beneath the Kamnik-Savinja Alps. Quiet roads, big peaks and almost no through traffic.

experiences.name: Kozjansko Hills to Brežice
experiences.description: Leave Celje for the spa town of Rogaška Slatina, then follow the Kozjansko hills past Podčetrtek and Kozje down to Brežice. Rolling farmland, small castles and vineyards with very little traffic.

sights.name: Župnijska cerkev Čudodelne Matere Božje in svete Marjete

experiences.name: Prlekija Wine Road
experiences.description: From Maribor along the Drava to Ptuj, often called the oldest town in Slovenia, then through the vineyard hills of Ormož, Jeruzalem and Ljutomer to Murska Sobota. A relaxed wine-country ride with cellars and viewpoints on the way.

sights.name: Župnijska cerkev blaženega Antona Martina Slomška
Župnijska cerkev svetih Roka in Sebastijana

experiences.name: Drava Valley to Slovenj Gradec
experiences.description: Leave Maribor along the foot of the Pohorje, follow the Drava west through Ruše, Radlje and Dravograd, then turn up the Mislinja valley to Slovenj Gradec. Fast river-valley curves with forested slopes on both sides and very little traffic.

sights.name: Župnijska cerkev blaženega Antona Martina Slomška
Župnijska cerkev svetih Simona in Jude Tadeja

experiences.name: Goričko to Lendava
experiences.description: Slovenia's gentle north-east: the Goričko hills around Grad and Gornji Petrovci, then across the Prekmurje plain to the vineyards above Lendava. Easy riding on quiet roads with long views.

sights.name: Župnijska cerkev svetih Kozme in Damijana
Lendavske Gorice, trig. točka I. reda

experiences.name: Sea to Summit
experiences.description: The full Slovenian sweep in one day: Piran on the Adriatic, the Karst, the Vipava Valley, the whole Soča valley and the Vršič pass to finish in Kranjska Gora. Long, varied and rewarding if you start early.

sights.name: Rimska vila in pristanišče Haliaetum Izola
Resti Castello di Vinchimberg o di Beka;Vinchimberch
Chiesa di San Rocco / Glesie di San Roc
Župnijska cerkev svetega Zenona in Marijinega imena

experiences.name: Kolpa Valley to the Adriatic
experiences.description: Ride the green border river Kolpa from Metlika, cross the Kočevje forests and the Notranjska karst and finish at the sea in Koper. Remote, forested and quiet for most of the day.

sights.name: Župnijska cerkev svetih Fabijana in Boštjana ter svetega Jerneja
Chiesa della Beata Vergine Immacolata / Cerkev Brezmadežne Device Marije

experiences.name: Julian Alps Epic
experiences.description: Soriška planina, the Petrovo Brdo road, the Soča valley and the Vršič pass in one long day from Ljubljana to Bled. A greatest-hits tour of the Julian Alps for a rider with a full tank and a long day.

sights.name: Župnijska cerkev svetih Mohorja in Fortunata

experiences.name: Kolpa Valley Border Road
experiences.description: Follow the Kolpa river along the Croatian border from Metlika through Vinica to Stari Trg ob Kolpi, then climb north over forested hills to Kočevje. Quiet, slow and green, with river swimming spots along the way.

sights.name: Debeli vrh, trig. točka I. reda
Župnijska cerkev svetih Fabijana in Boštjana ter svetega Jerneja
